2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Aurangabad Town P.S. Case No. 129 of 2021 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 05.04.2021 by the informant, Rajesh Kumar Singh.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant who wanted to run a business relating to aluminum foil container, the petitioner was paid a sum of Rs. 27,60,000/- when he was introduced by co-accused, Pankaj Kumar Sinha and Neeraj Patna High Court CR.
